Rashi on Ketubot 46a:14:1.hebrew: שכרן בקרקע - לרבי יהודה, מהו? כיון דמרבית גמר, כסף או אוכל בעינן דהוו מטלטלין כדכתיב לענין רבית, או דלמא לממון הוא דגמר ג"ש, ואפי' מקרקעי:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:14:1.english: [If] he hired them with land - According to Rabbi Yehuda, what is [the law]? Since he derives [it] from [the law of] interest, do we require money or food, which are movable property, as is written regarding interest, or perhaps it is for [any] monetary [payment] that he derives the gezerah shavah [verbal analogy], and even land [suffices]?

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:15:1.hebrew: על נשואין הראשונים - כנסה ולא הוציא ש"ר, וגרשה והחזירה, ואחר כך מוציא שם רע, "לא מצאתי בתולים לנישואין קמאי":
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:15:1.english: With regard to the first marriage - He married her and did not defame [her], and he divorced her and took her back, and afterward he defames [her, saying], "I did not find virginity [at] the first marriage."

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:16:1.hebrew: ולא ליבם - אין יבם שהוציא שם רע על נישואי אחיו בכלל פרשה זו לטעון טענת בתולים. איפשיטא ליה בעיא בתרייתא:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:16:1.english: And not to the yavam - A yavam who defamed [his yevama regarding] his brother's marriage is not included in this [biblical] passage to make a claim of [non-]virginity. The latter dilemma is resolved.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:18:1.hebrew: זינתה מעיקרא יש לה כתובה מנה - קסבר כנסה בחזקת בתולה ונמצאת בעולה, יש לה כתובה מנה:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:18:1.english: [If] she engaged in licentious sexual relations at the outset, she has a marriage contract of a maneh - [The tanna] holds [that if] he married her with the presumption [that she was] a virgin and she was found [to be] a non-virgin, she has a marriage contract of a maneh.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:1:1.hebrew: רב פפא אמר - לעולם מלקות ממש. ומאי ״בעל לוקה, לא בעל אינו לוקה״ דקאמר בהך ברייתא? ממון דמאה סלע קאמר:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:1:1.english: Rav Pappa said - Actually, [when Rabbi Yehuda says he is flogged in any case, it is] literal flogging; and what [is meant by] "if he had intercourse he is flogged, if he did not have intercourse he is not flogged" that is stated in that baraita? It refers to the money of a hundred sela.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:1:2.hebrew: חצי ערכו - לפי שניו, דערך קצוב בפרשה לפי השנים:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:1:2.english: Half his valuation - According to his years, for a valuation is fixed in the [Torah] portion according to [one's] years.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:21:1.english: Validators of virginity - Witnesses who will render these [witnesses] conspiring witnesses or contradict them, and validate your daughter as a complete virgin.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:22:1.english: The [proofs of the] fitness of my daughter's virginity - Witnesses who render his witnesses conspiring [witnesses].

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:25:1.hebrew: שלא מצינו שחלק הכתוב - משכבי אשה כתיב [ויקרא יח], שני משכבותיה שוין לכל משפט עריות:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:25:1.english: We have not found that Scripture distinguished - "[The] lyings of a woman" is written [Leviticus 18] — her two [manners of] lying are equal with respect to every law of forbidden sexual relations.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:25:2.hebrew: במוציא שם רע חלק - שאם הביא עדים שנבעלה ארוסתו שלא כדרכה, ונמצאו זוממין, אינו נותן מאה סלע, ד"לא מצאתי בתולים" כתיב, במקום בתולים:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:25:2.english: In [the case of] a defamer, [the Torah] distinguishes - For if he brought witnesses that his betrothed had intercourse in an atypical manner, and they were found to be conspiring witnesses, he does not pay a hundred sela, for "I did not find virginity" is written — [meaning] in the place of virginity.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:25:3.hebrew: אינו חייב עד שיבעול שלא כדרכה ויוציא שם רע בכדרכה - כלומר, כשבעל נאמרו דברים, ובעילתו אפילו היא שלא כדרכה, כי היכי דלא חלק בשאר עונשין. אבל ביאה של זנות שהוא מוציא לעז עליה, צריך שיאמר על ביאה כדרכה, ולקמן מפרש לה:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:25:3.english: He is not liable unless he has intercourse [with her] in an atypical manner and defames [her] in a typical manner - That is to say, when he has had intercourse, [the laws of defamation] were stated, and his intercourse [may] even [be] in an atypical manner, just as [Scripture] did not distinguish in [the case of] other punishments. However, [regarding] the licentious intercourse about which he spreads slander against her, he must speak of intercourse in a typical manner. And later [the Gemara] explains it.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:2:1.english: [It is a] decree [in the case of] "half of his valuation" - Which means half of the full valuation that is fixed for him according to [his] years.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:2:2.hebrew: אטו ערך חציו - עלי. והאומר ערך חציו עלי, או ערך ראשי או לבי עלי, נותן ערך שלם, דהוה ליה מעריך אבר שהנשמה תלויה בו. וגבי ערכין כתיב (ויקרא כ״ז:ב׳) בערכך נפשות, שהמעריך אבר שהנשמה תלויה בו נותן קצבה שנתנה בו תורה:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:2:2.english: Due to [the] valuation of half of himself - [Meaning, "the valuation of half of me is] upon me." And one who says, "The valuation of half of me [is] upon me," or "the valuation of my head or my heart [is] upon me," gives a full valuation, because he is [considered] one who vows the valuation of a limb upon which life depends. And regarding valuations it is written (Leviticus 27:2): "by your valuation, souls," [teaching] that one who vows the valuation of a limb upon which life depends gives the fixed amount that the Torah assigned to him.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:5:1.hebrew: ויסרו מויסרו ויסרו מבן - כתיב הכא ״ויסרו אותו״, וכתיב גבי סורר ומורה ״ויסרו״: מה להלן ״בן״ עמו, אף כאן ״בן״ עמו. והיינו ״ויסרו״ דהכא מ״ויסרו״ דהתם. וההוא ״ויסרו״ דהתם מ״בן״ שעמו — דלגמריה ל״בן״ שעמו על ״ויסרו״ דהכא. והדר יליף ״בן״ דאייתינן הכא מ״בן״ — ״והיה אם בן הכות״: מה התם מלקות, אף הכא מלקות:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:5:1.english: Chastise [yisru] from chastise [yisru], and chastise [yisru] from son [ben] - Here [regarding a defamer] it is written, "and they shall chastise [yisru] him" (Deuteronomy 22:18), and regarding a stubborn and rebellious son it is written, "and they shall chastise [yisru]" (Deuteronomy 21:18): just as there, [the word] "son" [ben] is with it, so too here, "son" [ben] is with it. And this is [what is meant by] "yisru" here from "yisru" there. And [as for] that "yisru" there [being derived] from "ben" that is with it — [that is] so that we may transfer "ben" that is with it onto "yisru" here. And then he derives "ben" that we brought here from "bin" [in] "And it shall be, if the wicked man deserve [bin] to be beaten" (Deuteronomy 25:2): just as there [it refers to] lashes, so too here [it refers to] lashes.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:6:1.hebrew: ונשמרת מכל דבר רע - וכל מקום שנאמר השמר, פן, ואל, אינו אלא לא תעשה:
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:6:1.english: Then you shall keep yourself from every evil thing - And wherever “keep yourself” [hishamer], “lest” [pen], or “do not” [al] is stated, it is nothing other than a negative commandment.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:7:1.english: For [the statement of] Rabbi Pineḥas - [This is taught] in Tractate Avodah Zarah.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:7:2.english: That [a person] should not think [impure thoughts] by day and come to impurity by night - For [the verse] "If there be among you a man," etc., is juxtaposed to it.

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:8:1.hebrew: רך לזה - ורכיל, לשון "רך לי תהיה":
Rashi on Ketubot 46a:8:1.english: Soft to this [litigant] - And [the word] rakhil [is] an expression of "be soft to me" [rakh li].

Rashi on Ketubot 46a:9:1.english: He did not say to witnesses - [Those] who testify about her adultery.

Tosafot on Ketubot 46a:12:1.hebrew: אתיא שימה שימה - נראה דלאו ג"ש גמורה היא, מדבעי בסמוך: "שכרן בקרקע או בפחות משוה פרוטה מהו?", אף ע"ג דאין רבית בקרקע אלא דווקא דומיא דכסף ואוכל, ולא בפחות משוה פרוטה, מדאמר בריש איזהו נשך (ב"מ דף סא. ושם): "למה לי דכתב רחמנא לאו בגזל, לאו ברבית, לאו באונאה? ואם יש רבית בפחות משוה פרוטה, הא איצטריך לאו ברבית לפחות משוה פרוטה, והנך נמי לא ילפינן מיניה, דמה לרבית שכן ישנה בפחות משוה פרוטה". והא דאמר בערכין (דף לא. ושם) גבי בתי ערי חומה: "רבית הוא, אלא שהתורה התירתו" — התם חשיב ריבית לפי שעומד בבית בשכר המתנת מעותיו. אבל אם אדם לוה שדה שאם שטפה נהר יפרע לו שדה וחצי, או עשר גפנים טעונות פגין או בוסר בי"א דלכולי עלמא כקרקע דמיא לשבועה ולכל דבר — שמא כי האי גוונא לא הוי רבית בקרקע:
Tosafot on Ketubot 46a:12:1.english: [It] is derived [by a verbal analogy between] “placing” [and] “placing” - It appears that this is not a full-fledged gezerah shavah [verbal analogy], since [the Gemara] asks immediately below: “What is [the law if] he hired them with land, or with less than the value of a perutah?” — even though [the prohibition of] interest does not apply to land, but rather specifically [to things] similar to money and food, and not to less than the value of a perutah, as [the Gemara] says at the beginning of [chapter] Eizehu Neshekh (Bava Metzia 61a and there): “Why do I need the Merciful One to write a prohibition regarding robbery, a prohibition regarding interest, [and] a prohibition regarding overcharging? And if [the prohibition of] interest applied to less than the value of a perutah, [then] the prohibition regarding interest would be needed for less than the value of a perutah, and we could also not derive the others from it, for what [comparison is there] to interest, which applies even to less than the value of a perutah?” And [as for] that which [the Gemara] says in Arakhin (31a and there) regarding houses in walled cities: “It is interest, except that the Torah permitted it” — there it is considered interest because he resides in the house as compensation for waiting for his money. However, if a person borrows a field [on condition] that if a river floods it he will repay him a field and a half, or ten vines laden with unripe figs or unripe grapes — [which,] according to some (בי"א), according to everyone are considered like land with respect to an oath and with respect to every matter — perhaps in such a case [it] is not [considered] interest on land.

Tosafot on Ketubot 46a:23:1.hebrew: בשלמא לר"א בן יעקב היינו דכתיב ופרשו השמלה - תימה: דע"כ בשיש עדים שזינתה איירי, דמשום שלא ימצאו על השמלה דם בתולים אין להורגה; א"כ, מה תועלת יש בפרישת השמלה? דפשיטא דלא מיתכחשי עדים בשביל כך, דיש לתלות שהנואף הטה. וי"ל, דסבר דלא מיחייב אלא אם כן העיז פניו לשנות הידוע — שמחציף להראות השמלה בלא בתולים לבית דין, ונמצא שקרן שהיא מלאה דם:
Tosafot on Ketubot 46a:23:1.english: Granted, according to Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya'akov, this is as it is written, "And they shall spread the garment" - [This is] perplexing: perforce [the verse] is speaking of [a case] where there are witnesses that she committed adultery, for merely because they do not find virginity blood on the garment, one does not execute her; if so, what benefit is there in spreading the garment? For it is obvious that the witnesses are not contradicted by this, since one can attribute [the presence of blood] to the adulterer having had unnatural intercourse. And one can say that he holds that [the husband] is not liable unless he acted brazenly to deny what is known — in that he has the audacity to show the garment [as being] without virginity [blood] to the court, and he is found to be a liar, as it is full of blood.

Tosafot on Ketubot 46a:24:1.hebrew: דברים ששם לה - לא מלשון שמלה דריש, דהא מפרש בברייתא דמייתי שמלה — כשמלה חדשה, אלא לישנא דקרא נקט: "ושם לה עלילות דברים":
Tosafot on Ketubot 46a:24:1.english: Matters that he placed against her [she-sam la] - He is not expounding [this] from the word "garment" [simlah], for it explains in the baraita that he cites [that] "garment" [means] "like a new garment"; rather, he adopts the phrasing of the verse: "and he placed against her [ve-sam la] wanton charges."
